SGD and Adam aren't the only optimisers..zh:
SGD 与 Adam 并非仅有的优化器。让五种非 SGD 方法在同一个二维损失曲面上竞速，
          观察各自在哪里跃进而又在哪里停滞。
SGD and Adam aren't the only optimisers..src:
SGD and Adam aren't the only optimisers. Race five
          non-SGD methods on the same 2D loss surface and watch
          where each leaps and stalls.

@@T0@@~16 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Opt.zh:
@@T0@@约 16 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@优化 · 深度学习理论@@T3@@

SGD with momentum is the workhorse of de.zh:
带动量的 SGD 是深度学习的主力，原因在于
          （a）它可扩展 — 每一步只做一次梯度求值，代价低廉；
          （b）在单遍训练中，噪声是一种特性而非缺陷；
          （c）小批量带来的隐式正则化
          免费提供了泛化能力。Adam 及其同类算法（AdamW、Lion、
          Sophia）继承了这些优点，并加入了逐参数的自适应
          学习率。
SGD with momentum is the workhorse of de.src:
SGD with momentum is the workhorse of deep learning because
          (a) it scales — one gradient evaluation per step is cheap,
          (b) noise is a feature, not a bug, on a single-pass training
          run, and (c) the implicit regularisation of small batches
          gives free generalisation. Adam and its cousins (AdamW, Lion,
          Sophia) inherit those advantages and add adaptive per-parameter
          learning rates.

But: SGD throws away two things..zh: 但是：SGD 丢弃了两样东西。
But: SGD throws away two things..src: But: SGD throws away two things.

@@T0@@Curvature.@@T1@@ The Hessian tells.zh:
@@T0@@曲率。@@T1@@ Hessian 矩阵揭示了
            局部几何结构 — 损失陡峭的方向
            （小步长）与平坦的方向（大步长）。SGD 完全忽略它。
            在条件数为 $\kappa$ 的二次函数上，SGD 需要
            $O(\kappa \log \tfrac{1}{\varepsilon})$ 步；而 Newton 法只需
            $\log\log \tfrac{1}{\varepsilon}$。
@@T0@@Curvature.@@T1@@ The Hessian tells.src: Curvature. The Hessian tells you the local geometry — directions where the loss is steep (small step) vs flat (big step). SGD ignores it entirely. On a quadratic with condition number $\kappa$, SGD needs $O(\kappa \log \tfrac{1}{\varepsilon})$ steps; Newton needs $\log\log \tfrac{1}{\varepsilon}$.

@@T0@@Cross-parameter geometry.@@T1@@ Ad.zh:
@@T0@@参数间的几何结构。@@T1@@ Adam 的对角
            预条件子忽略了参数间的相关性。自然梯度
            方法（K-FAC、Shampoo）以分块方式恢复它们。
@@T0@@Cross-parameter geometry.@@T1@@ Ad.src: Cross-parameter geometry. Adam's diagonal preconditioner ignores correlations. Natural-gradient methods (K-FAC, Shampoo) recover them block-wise.

When are these worth paying for? When (i.zh:
这些方法何时值得付出代价？当（i）你能承担全批量或大批量
          梯度，（ii）维度小到足以存储或求逆曲率矩阵，
          或（iii）你根本没有梯度，只能退回到
          诸如 CMA-ES 与 SPSA 之类的函数值方法时。
When are these worth paying for? When (i.src:
When are these worth paying for? When (i) you can afford
          full-batch or large-batch gradients, (ii) the dimensionality
          is small enough to store/invert curvature, or (iii) you have
          no gradient at all and must fall back to function-value
          methods like CMA-ES and SPSA.

@@T0@@Newton's method.@@T1@@ Use the Hes.zh:
@@T0@@牛顿法。@@T1@@ 使用 Hessian
            矩阵 $H$，沿 $-H^{-1}\nabla f$ 方向迭代。具有二次局部收敛性。
            代价：构造 $H$ 需 $O(d^2)$，求逆需 $O(d^3)$。
            当 $d$ > 约 $10^4$ 时不实用。
@@T0@@Newton's method.@@T1@@ Use the Hes.src: Newton's method. Use the Hessian $H$ and step $-H^{-1}\nabla f$. Quadratic local convergence. Cost: forming $H$ in $O(d^2)$ and inverting in $O(d^3)$. Impractical for $d$ > ~$10^4$.

@@T0@@BFGS / L-BFGS.@@T1@@ Maintain a lo.zh:
@@T0@@BFGS / L-BFGS。@@T1@@ 依据历史梯度维护
            $H^{-1}$ 的低秩近似。是中等规模（<100 万参数）
            深度学习的主力。scipy.minimize 的默认方法；@@T2@@jax.scipy.optimize@@T3@@
            也内置了它。
@@T0@@BFGS / L-BFGS.@@T1@@ Maintain a lo.src: BFGS / L-BFGS. Maintain a low-rank approximation of $H^{-1}$ from past gradients. The workhorse for medium-scale (<1M parameter) DL. scipy.minimize's default; jax.scipy.optimize ships it.

@@T0@@Natural gradient.@@T1@@ Step\n.zh:
@@T0@@自然梯度。@@T1@@ 沿
            $-F^{-1}\nabla f$ 方向迭代，其中 $F$ 为 Fisher 信息
            矩阵。具有重参数化不变性；是
            K-FAC 与 Shampoo 的核心。在许多
            场景下于 RNN / GAN 上胜过 Adam。
@@T0@@Natural gradient.@@T1@@ Step\n.src: Natural gradient. Step $-F^{-1}\nabla f$ where $F$ is the Fisher information matrix. Invariant to reparameterisation; the heart of K-FAC and Shampoo. Beats Adam on RNNs / GANs in many settings.

@@T0@@CMA-ES (evolutionary).@@T1@@ Sampl.zh:
@@T0@@CMA-ES（进化式）。@@T1@@ 从高斯分布中
            采样一个种群；将均值与
            协方差朝最优样本更新。无需梯度，
            对噪声稳健；是强化学习超参数搜索的标准方法。
@@T0@@CMA-ES (evolutionary).@@T1@@ Sampl.src: CMA-ES (evolutionary). Sample a population from a Gaussian; update the mean and covariance toward the best samples. Gradient-free, robust to noise; standard in RL hyperparameter search.

@@T0@@SPSA (gradient-free finite-differe.zh:
@@T0@@SPSA（无梯度的有限差分）。@@T1@@
            用一个随机 ±1 向量一次性扰动全部参数，
            仅以两次求值的有限差分估计梯度。
            在只能获得函数值的情形下最为适用。
@@T0@@SPSA (gradient-free finite-differe.src: SPSA (gradient-free finite-difference). Perturb all parameters once with random ±1, estimate the gradient with a single 2-evaluation finite difference. Optimal when only function values are available.

Taylor-expand the loss around the curren.zh: 在当前迭代点 $w_t$ 附近对损失作 Taylor 展开：
Taylor-expand the loss around the curren.src: Taylor-expand the loss around the current iterate $w_t$:

Minimise this quadratic in $\\Delta w$ b.zh:
令该二次式关于 $\Delta w$ 的梯度为零，
          即可求得其最小值。解之得 $\Delta w = -H^{-1}\nabla f$，
          即牛顿步。在完美的二次函数上，一步即可
          抵达最优解；在光滑函数上，收敛阶为
          二次 — 误差每次迭代后平方。实践中
          必须进行阻尼：$w_{t+1} = w_t - \alpha_t H^{-1}\nabla f$，
          其中 $\alpha_t$ 由线搜索确定；并在 Hessian 非正定之时
          用 $H + \lambda I$ 对其加以稳定
          （Levenberg–Marquardt）。
Minimise this quadratic in $\\Delta w$ b.src:
Minimise this quadratic in $\Delta w$ by setting its
          gradient to zero. Solving gives $\Delta w = -H^{-1}\nabla f$,
          which is the Newton step. On a perfect quadratic, one step
          reaches the optimum; on a smooth function, the rate is
          quadratic — the error squares each iteration. In practice
          you must damp: $w_{t+1} = w_t - \alpha_t H^{-1}\nabla f$
          with $\alpha_t$ from a line search, and stabilise the Hessian
          with $H + \lambda I$ when it's not positive-definite
          (Levenberg–Marquardt).

BFGS — the rank-2 secret to L-BFGS.zh: BFGS — L-BFGS 背后的秩 2 秘密
BFGS — the rank-2 secret to L-BFGS.src: BFGS — the rank-2 secret to L-BFGS

BFGS maintains a Hessian-inverse approxi.zh:
BFGS 维护一个 Hessian 逆矩阵的近似 $B$，
          并使其每一步都更精确。在观测到步长
          $s_t = w_{t+1} - w_t$ 与梯度变化 $y_t = \nabla f_{t+1}
          - \nabla f_t$ 之后，它通过一个秩 2 扰动更新 $B$：
BFGS maintains a Hessian-inverse approxi.src:
BFGS maintains a Hessian-inverse approximation $B$ that gets
          better every step. After observing the step
          $s_t = w_{t+1} - w_t$ and gradient change $y_t = \nabla f_{t+1}
          - \nabla f_t$, it updates $B$ by a rank-2 perturbation:

Two properties make this magical:.zh: 有两个性质使这一更新如此巧妙：

@@T0@@Secant condition.@@T1@@ The update.zh:
@@T0@@割线条件。@@T1@@ 该更新满足
            $B_{t+1} y_t = s_t$ — 即它正确地预测了
            你刚刚观测到的曲率。
@@T0@@Secant condition.@@T1@@ The update.src: Secant condition. The update satisfies $B_{t+1} y_t = s_t$ — i.e. it correctly predicts the curvature you just observed.

@@T0@@Positive-definiteness preserved.@@.zh:
@@T0@@保持正定性。@@T1@@ 若
            $B_t \succ 0$ 且 $s_t^\top y_t > 0$（曲率
            条件成立），则 $B_{t+1} \succ 0$。
@@T0@@Positive-definiteness preserved.@@.src: Positive-definiteness preserved. If $B_t \succ 0$ and $s_t^\top y_t > 0$ (curvature condition), then $B_{t+1} \succ 0$.

@@T0@@L-BFGS@@T1@@ stores only the last.zh:
@@T0@@L-BFGS@@T1@@ 仅存储最近的 $m$ 组配对 $(s_t,
          y_t)$（通常 $m=10$），而非完整矩阵，并通过一个双循环递归在
          $O(md)$ 时间内计算 $B \nabla f$。这
          正是它在完整牛顿法无法胜任时仍能扩展至数百万参数
          的原因。
@@T0@@L-BFGS@@T1@@ stores only the last.src: L-BFGS stores only the last $m$ pairs $(s_t, y_t)$ (typically $m=10$) instead of the full matrix, applying $B \nabla f$ via a two-loop recursion in $O(md)$ time. That's why it scales to millions of parameters when full Newton can't.

Natural gradient — geometry of probabili.zh: 自然梯度 — 概率的几何

For a probabilistic model $p_\\theta(x)$.zh:
对于概率模型 $p_\theta(x)$，自然梯度
          以逆 Fisher 信息矩阵对普通梯度进行预条件：
For a probabilistic model $p_\\theta(x)$.src:
For a probabilistic model $p_\theta(x)$, the natural gradient
          preconditions the ordinary gradient with the inverse Fisher
          information matrix:

The Fisher $F$ is the Hessian of the KL.zh:
Fisher 矩阵 $F$ 是相对当前模型的 KL 散度的
          Hessian 矩阵。沿 $-F^{-1}\nabla L$ 方向迭代可使
          相邻两次迭代之间的 KL 变化保持有界 — 该步长
          于是变得 @@T0@@在分布流形上具备几何感知能力@@T1@@。
          具体后果如下：
The Fisher $F$ is the Hessian of the KL.src: The Fisher $F$ is the Hessian of the KL divergence to the current model. Stepping along $-F^{-1}\nabla L$ keeps the KL change between consecutive iterates bounded — the step becomes geometry-aware in the manifold of distributions. Concrete consequences:

@@T0@@Reparameterisation invariance.@@T1.zh:
@@T0@@重参数化不变性。@@T1@@ 若你
            改变参数坐标，自然梯度的更新与参数本身
            以相同方式变换，因此对分布的实际更新
            保持不变。朴素梯度则 @@T2@@不具@@T3@@ 不变性；这
            正是 SGD 对激活尺度选择如此敏感的原因。
@@T0@@Reparameterisation invariance.@@T1.src: Reparameterisation invariance. If you change the parameter coordinates, the natural-gradient update transforms the same way the parameters do, so the actual update on the distribution is the same. Vanilla gradient is not invariant; this is why SGD is so sensitive to choice of activation scales.

@@T0@@K-FAC.@@T1@@ Approximates $F$ as b.zh:
@@T0@@K-FAC。@@T1@@ 将 $F$ 近似为分块对角
            形式，其分块具有 Kronecker 因子结构，从而使大型网络的
            求逆变得可行。较早的 DeepMind 强化学习
            论文中有所采用；@@T2@@Shampoo@@T3@@（Anil 等人，2020）是
            其现代后继者，已被用于部分 2024–2025 年的大语言模型预训练
            流程。
@@T0@@K-FAC.@@T1@@ Approximates $F$ as b.src: K-FAC. Approximates $F$ as block-diagonal with Kronecker-factored blocks, making the inverse tractable for big nets. Adopted in older DeepMind RL papers; Shampoo (Anil et al., 2020) is the modern descendant, used in some 2024–2025 LLM pretraining runs.

@@T0@@TRPO / NPG.@@T1@@ Trust-region pol.zh:
@@T0@@TRPO / NPG。@@T1@@ 信赖域策略
            优化本质上就是自然梯度的策略改进 —
            它至今仍是关于同策略强化学习为何需要
            KL 约束的最清晰推导。
@@T0@@TRPO / NPG.@@T1@@ Trust-region pol.src: TRPO / NPG. Trust-region policy optimisation is natural-gradient policy improvement — still the cleanest derivation of why on-policy RL needs a KL constraint.

Loss surface contour + each optimiser's.zh: 损失曲面等高线及各优化器的轨迹。最终损失值显示在图例中。
Loss surface contour + each optimiser's.src: Loss surface contour + each optimiser's trajectory. Final loss values shown in the legend.

Gradient-free: CMA-ES and SPSA.zh: 无梯度方法：CMA-ES 与 SPSA

Suppose you can compute $f(w)$ but not $.zh:
假设你能计算 $f(w)$，却无法计算 $\nabla f(w)$。这
          正是强化学习超参数搜索、基于模拟器的设计、
          硬件在环调优以及某些量子实验所处的
          情形。有两类算法占据主导。
Suppose you can compute $f(w)$ but not $.src:
Suppose you can compute $f(w)$ but not $\nabla f(w)$. This
          is the regime for RL hyperparameter search, simulator-based
          design, hardware-in-the-loop tuning, and certain quantum
          experiments. Two algorithms dominate.

@@T0@@CMA-ES (Covariance Matrix Adaptati.zh:
@@T0@@CMA-ES（协方差矩阵自适应进化
          策略）。@@T1@@ 维护一个高斯搜索分布
          $\mathcal{N}(m_t, \sigma_t^2 C_t)$。每一代执行：
@@T0@@CMA-ES (Covariance Matrix Adaptati.src: CMA-ES (Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy). Maintain a Gaussian search distribution $\mathcal{N}(m_t, \sigma_t^2 C_t)$. At each generation:

Sample a population of $\\lambda$ candid.zh: 采样一个含 $\lambda$ 个候选的种群；

Evaluate $f$ at each; sort by fitness;.zh: 对每个候选求 $f$ 值；按适应度排序；
Evaluate $f$ at each; sort by fitness;.src: Evaluate $f$ at each; sort by fitness;

Recombine the top $\\mu$ to form the new.zh: 对前 $\mu$ 个进行重组，构成新的均值 $m_{t+1}$；
Recombine the top $\\mu$ to form the new.src: Recombine the top $\mu$ to form the new mean $m_{t+1}$;

Adapt $\\sigma_t$ (step size) based on t.zh: 依据累计进化路径的长度调整 $\sigma_t$（步长）；
Adapt $\\sigma_t$ (step size) based on t.src:
Adapt $\sigma_t$ (step size) based on the cumulative
            evolution path's length;

Adapt $C_t$ to align with successful dir.zh: 调整 $C_t$ 使之与成功的方向对齐。
Adapt $C_t$ to align with successful dir.src: Adapt $C_t$ to align with successful directions.

The adaptive covariance is what makes CM.src:
The adaptive covariance is what makes CMA-ES competitive —
          it learns the local conditioning from successes and failures
          without computing a Hessian.

@@T0@@SPSA (Simultaneous Perturbation St.zh:
@@T0@@SPSA（同时扰动随机
          逼近）。@@T1@@ 选取一个随机的 $\pm 1$ 向量
          $\Delta_t$（Rademacher 分布）；在 $w_t \pm c_t \Delta_t$ 处求 $f$ 值；
          并以 @@T2@@单次@@T3@@ 两点
          有限差分估计梯度：
@@T0@@SPSA (Simultaneous Perturbation St.src: SPSA (Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation). Pick a random $\pm 1$ vector $\Delta_t$ (Rademacher); evaluate $f$ at $w_t \pm c_t \Delta_t$; estimate the gradient with a single 2-point finite difference:

Two function evaluations per step, regar.zh:
每步只需两次函数求值，与维度无关。
          这正是其巧妙之处：普通有限差分需要 $2d$
          次求值，而 SPSA 只付出固定的 2 次。代价是方差：
          你需要大量步数以及逐渐收缩的 $a_t, c_t$ 才能收敛，
          但每步的代价与维度无关。
Two function evaluations per step, regar.src:
Two function evaluations per step, regardless of dimension.
          That's the magic: where ordinary finite differences cost $2d$
          evaluations, SPSA pays a fixed 2. The trade-off is variance:
          you need many steps and shrinking $a_t, c_t$ to converge,
          but the per-step cost is dimension-independent.

@@T0@@L-BFGS.@@T1@@ Smooth full-batch lo.zh:
@@T0@@L-BFGS。@@T1@@ 适用于参数量至多
            约 100 万的光滑全批量损失。典型用途：物理信息神经网络、
            小数据微调、数值方法。
@@T0@@L-BFGS.@@T1@@ Smooth full-batch lo.src: L-BFGS. Smooth full-batch losses up to ~1M parameters. Typical use: physics-informed nets, small-data fine-tunes, numerical methods.

@@T0@@K-FAC / Shampoo (natural gradient).zh:
@@T0@@K-FAC / Shampoo（自然梯度）。@@T1@@
            适用于大型网络与稳定训练。被那些在 Adam 出现平台期的
            超大型大语言模型与 RNN 上开展研究的实验室所采用。
@@T0@@K-FAC / Shampoo (natural gradient).src: K-FAC / Shampoo (natural gradient). Big nets, stable training. Adopted by labs running very-large LLMs and RNNs where Adam plateaus.

@@T0@@CMA-ES.@@T1@@ Black-box hyperparam.zh:
@@T0@@CMA-ES。@@T1@@ 黑箱超参数
            搜索；以奖励塑形的强化学习；梯度
            噪声较大或不可得的任务。
@@T0@@CMA-ES.@@T1@@ Black-box hyperparam.src: CMA-ES. Black-box hyperparameter search; reward-shaped RL; tasks where the gradient is noisy or unavailable.

@@T0@@SPSA.@@T1@@ Hardware-in-the-loop t.zh:
@@T0@@SPSA。@@T1@@ 硬件在环调优，
            以及每次求值都是一次前向模拟的基于模拟器的设计。
            量子线路优化使其广为人知。
@@T0@@SPSA.@@T1@@ Hardware-in-the-loop t.src: SPSA. Hardware-in-the-loop tuning, simulator-based design where every evaluation is a forward simulation. Quantum-circuit optimisation popularised it.

@@T0@@Stick with SGD/Adam.@@T1@@ Mini-ba.zh:
@@T0@@坚持使用 SGD/Adam。@@T1@@ 适用于含数百万
            参数、使用随机梯度的迷你批量深度学习。
            计算 $H$ 的代价超过其带来的收益。
@@T0@@Stick with SGD/Adam.@@T1@@ Mini-ba.src: Stick with SGD/Adam. Mini-batch DL with millions of parameters and a stochastic gradient. Cost of computing $H$ exceeds the gain.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.zh:
@@T0@@最后总结。@@T1@@
          合适的优化器取决于每一类信息的代价。SGD 丢弃了曲率
          （前向与反向传播代价低廉，无需 Hessian）。L-BFGS / 牛顿法
          每步代价更高，但收敛更快。无梯度方法每步代价更高
          @@T2@@且@@T3@@ 忽略梯度，但在无梯度可用之时
          便显示出优势。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.src: Final takeaway. The right optimiser depends on the cost of each piece of information. SGD throws away curvature (cheap forward+ backward, no Hessian). L-BFGS / Newton spend more per step but converge faster. Gradient-free methods spend more per step and ignore gradients but win when there aren't any to use.

DL pretraining, mini-batch.zh: 深度学习预训练，迷你批量

Large nets where stability matters.zh: 稳定性至关重要的大型网络

Slow but dimension-independent per step.zh: 较慢，但每步代价与维度无关

@@T0@@Physics-informed nets, neural PDEs.zh:
@@T0@@物理信息神经网络、神经 PDE。@@T1@@
            在数千步 Adam 之后改用 L-BFGS 作最终收敛 —
            Adam 抵达盆地，L-BFGS 则在其内部完成
            下降。这是标准的 PINN 做法。
@@T0@@Physics-informed nets, neural PDEs.src: Physics-informed nets, neural PDEs. Use L-BFGS for the final tightening after a few thousand Adam steps — Adam reaches the basin, L-BFGS finishes the descent inside it. This is the standard PINN recipe.

@@T0@@Large-scale RL.@@T1@@ Natural-grad.zh:
@@T0@@大规模强化学习。@@T1@@ 为求稳定，可使用
            自然梯度的 TRPO；PPO 是更廉价的一阶近似，
            采用截断的 KL 代理目标。若策略网络的规模允许，
            可使用 Shampoo。
@@T0@@Large-scale RL.@@T1@@ Natural-grad.src: Large-scale RL. Natural-gradient TRPO for stability; PPO is the cheaper first-order approximation with a clipped KL surrogate. Use Shampoo if you can afford it on the policy network.

@@T0@@Hyperparameter / architecture sear.zh:
@@T0@@超参数 / 架构搜索。@@T1@@
            若你有数十个连续超参数且能承担 $\sim 100$ 次求值，
            可使用 CMA-ES。若求值次数更少、且空间求值
            代价更低，则使用贝叶斯优化。
@@T0@@Hyperparameter / architecture sear.src: Hyperparameter / architecture search. CMA-ES if you have a few dozen continuous hyperparameters and can afford $\sim 100$ evaluations. Bayesian optimisation for fewer evaluations on cheaper-to-evaluate spaces.

@@T0@@Quantum / analog hardware.@@T1@@ S.zh:
@@T0@@量子 / 模拟硬件。@@T1@@ SPSA 是
            变分量子特征求解器（VQE）的标准优化器，
            原因恰恰在于每一次“求值”都需要运行一个
            量子线路。
@@T0@@Quantum / analog hardware.@@T1@@ S.src: Quantum / analog hardware. SPSA is the standard variational-quantum-eigensolver (VQE) optimiser precisely because each "evaluation" requires running a quantum circuit.

meta.title: 超越梯度下降
meta.tagline: 牛顿法、BFGS、自然梯度、进化式、无梯度 — 五种非 SGD 思想，在二维损失上实时演示
meta.summary: SGD/Adam 并非仅有的选择。让牛顿法、BFGS、自然梯度、CMA-ES（进化式）以及无梯度的 SPSA 优化器在同一个二维非凸损失上竞速。观察各自在哪里跃至最优、在哪里陷入停滞，以及在你的实验中应当选用哪一种。
highlights: 五种优化器在同一个二维非凸曲面上实时运行；其轨迹相互叠加。
为每种方法显示步数计数器与最终损失，便于比较收敛代价。
损失曲面选择器（二次曲面 / Rosenbrock / 双碗）可切换，显示哪种优化器更占优势。
何时选用何种方法 — 实验室决策矩阵。
